lines: d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jae Robertson is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d32: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d32: 🕯️ Jae Robertson is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d32: What Jae kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d32: "Jae's gone." Esperanza looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jae." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d32: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Dwayne blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.

d32: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d32: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jae Robertson, 32 days. The mantle passes to Dwayne Bianchi.
d32: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Dwayne Bianchi, 40 — a sign painter. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Green Thumb, Literally.
d32: The village's quarrel was with Jae — and Jae is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d32: At the grave, Esperanza, Eli, Araya and 6 more speak for Dwayne — "Jae trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d32: The fire knew Dwayne before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
